card.title: Ask Around the Missing Detail
card.instruction: Find one hidden fact by asking about everything surrounding it and never naming it directly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Whose coat needed the second cup of tea while I was out?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: True. Who was keeping that one warm from the inside?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still on the cup. Did its owner take sugar?
